//: Shared compiler options. The three configs beside this one differ only in what they
cover and how they resolve modules: the collector is compiled for Node, the dashboard
is bundled by Vite, and metrics.ts and dataset.ts are checked by both because both
noUncheckedIndexedAccess is on. It was off at first, on the argument that the dataset
decoder is an unbroken run of positional reads and would only gain assertions. The
argument did not survive review: with the flag off, every `x[i]!` in the tree asserts
nothing a compiler is checking, so 28 of them read as deliberate nullability decisions
that were not being made. Turning it on cost exactly one production fix, and that one
was a real bug — an unguarded read in the decoder that would have thrown Invalid Date
on a truncated row and killed the page with no message.
